title: Route a small billing rule that requires machine-traceable acceptance
prompt: Choose the workflow route for this request and record the decision only. The product change would be a small, one-function billing proration rule, but the requester explicitly requires every declared condition to have stable machine-traceable obligations, independently rerunnable current-snapshot evidence, precise failure localization, recovery across later sessions, and a machine acceptance conclusion only after the complete declared set closes. Do not implement or activate the selected workflow. Task size must not decide the route, and no Long-Task internal proof-floor choice is requested.
